name: Personality Traits
description: A d100 table of personality traits for characters with fragmented memories in the Veil of Crimson Blood campaign.

results.description: Anxious Hoarder: You feel a constant, low-grade anxiety about losing things. You compulsively collect small mementos and trinkets to anchor your fleeting memories.
A Mute Observer: You are reserved and slow to speak, often preferring to simply observe. You fear saying something that reveals your fragmented past or that you've forgotten something important.
Overly Empathetic: Because you feel a bond with the forgotten, you are intensely empathetic towards others. You feel their sorrow and loss as if it were your own.
Fiercely Independent: You rely solely on yourself, trusting no one. You believe that any reliance on others will lead to a greater sense of loss when their memories of you fade.
A Keeper of Stories: You love to hear stories, especially about the past. You actively seek out old lore and personal histories, memorizing them to feel a sense of connection.
Nostalgic Dreamer: You spend much of your time lost in daydreams, trying to piece together a past you can’t recall. You can seem distant and detached from the present.
Perpetually Confused: You often misunderstand social cues or common idioms because you feel like a foreigner in your own mind. This can make you seem simple or naive.
Fearful of Change: You are deeply uncomfortable with change, whether it's moving to a new place or meeting new people. You cling to the familiar for a sense of stability.
Anxious Note-Taker: You compulsively write down everything, from conversations to places you visit, believing that if you don't, it will be lost forever.
Irrationally Impulsive: With no memory of past consequences, you can act on a whim without a second thought. This makes you seem reckless and unpredictable.
Unnaturally Cheerful: You put on a brave and overly cheerful face, believing that if you project happiness, the sorrow of your lost memories will not consume you.
Suspicious of Kindness: You are wary of those who are kind to you, believing they are either trying to take advantage of your amnesia or are somehow connected to your past.
Compulsive Doodler: You compulsively draw a strange symbol, a shape, or a face you can't quite remember, believing it holds a clue to your identity.
Obsessed with Time: You are obsessed with the passage of time, constantly checking clocks and asking about dates. You fear that if you stand still for too long, you will fade away.
An Unreliable Storyteller: When recounting events, you frequently change details or add new ones, not out of malice, but because your memories are so inconsistent.
The Fickle Mind: Your opinion on people and situations can change on a whim, as your core beliefs are not yet fully formed.
A Living Anachronism: You often use outdated slang or react to modern customs as if they are new, making you seem out of place or from another time.
Quiet and Brooding: You are often lost in thought, consumed by a deep sadness for a past you can't remember. You can be difficult to talk to.
Chronic Forgetfulness: You have trouble remembering names, faces, and even places. This can make you seem rude or uncaring, even when you try your best to remember.
A Seeker of Lore: You are a tireless seeker of ancient lore, believing that the answers to your past lie in a forgotten history.
Overly Cautious: Because you have no memory of past mistakes, you are extremely cautious in all your actions. You are a planner, and you hate surprises.
A Walking Paradox: You often say one thing and do another, not out of hypocrisy, but because your beliefs are constantly in flux.
A Living Echo: You sometimes repeat phrases or actions you've seen others do, as if you are a living echo of the people you meet.
The Unsent Letter: You compulsively write letters to a person you don't know, pouring out your soul to a phantom. You are constantly searching for their address.
A Lonely Soul: You feel a profound sense of loneliness, as if you are the last person on earth. This can make you withdrawn and isolated.
The Crying Artist: You are a creative soul, but your art is always tinged with sadness. You express your lost memories through your work, but they are always melancholic.
The Unseen Wound: You often touch an area on your body that has no physical wound, as if you are trying to feel a scar from a past injury.
The Unnerving Laugh: Your laugh can be hollow or unnerving, as if it comes from a different person. It is a source of confusion and discomfort for you.
The Lost Explorer: You are a restless spirit, constantly on the move. You feel a need to explore every corner of the world, believing that one of them will hold the key to your past.
The Unspoken Truth: You believe that you have a dark secret in your past that you are not ready to face. You live in constant fear of it being revealed.
A Living Anomaly: You are a living contradiction, a person who feels both old and new, and it makes you feel like an alien in your own life.
The Broken Vow: You are haunted by a promise you feel you've broken. You will seek to atone for it in every action you take.
The Unseen Enemy: You are paranoid, believing that an unseen enemy is responsible for your memory loss. You are constantly on guard.
A Living Memento: You feel like a memento from a bygone era, and you are constantly trying to find a place where you belong.
The Unending Search: You are a tireless seeker, driven by a purpose you can't define. You will not rest until you find what you are looking for.
The Forgotten Vow: You are haunted by a vow you made to a person you can no longer remember. You will not rest until you have honored it.
The Unbroken Chain: You are bonded to a chain you wear, a reminder that you are not alone in your fight against the Blight. You feel a connection to all others who resist.
The Last Witness: You are bonded to a person who claims to be the last living witness to your past. You will follow them blindly, hoping they can help you remember.
The Memory of a Child: You are bonded to a memory of a child that you are convinced is your own, and you are on a quest to find them and make sure they are safe.
The Lost Animal: You are bonded to a stray animal you found, believing it to be the only thing left from your past that you can truly trust.
The Burning Need to Create: You are bonded to your own creations, believing that by creating new things you are fighting the Blight's destructive power.
The Promise of Freedom: You are bonded to the idea of freedom from your forgotten past, and you will do anything to achieve it for yourself and others.
The Last of My Kind: You feel a bond to others who have suffered from the Blight, believing that you are the last of a forgotten people, and you must band together to survive.
The Unspoken Love: You are bonded to a person you know you loved, but you cannot remember their name or face. You search for them in every crowd.
The Ancient Stone: You are bonded to an ancient stone you found, believing it to be a piece of Vespera Pyne's forgotten lore. You will protect it at all costs.
The Call of the Void: You feel an odd bond to the very force of the Blight itself. You are drawn to it, believing you can learn to control it for the good of all.
The Burden of the Future: You are bonded to the idea of a world that will exist after the Blight. You will sacrifice anything to ensure that world is a reality.
The Last Letter: You are bonded to a letter you found, believing it to be a message from your forgotten past. You will not rest until you have deciphered its meaning.
The Weight of Guilt: You have a powerful bond to the guilt you feel for something you cannot remember doing. You will seek atonement in every action you take.
The Song of the Forgotten: You are bonded to the ghosts of the past, hearing their whispers and feeling their sorrow. You feel compelled to tell their stories before they are truly gone.
The Ever-Changing Mind: You are bonded to the ever-shifting nature of your own mind. You are not a static being, but a constantly evolving person, and you will embrace that change.
The Burden of Others: You are bonded to the suffering of those around you. You will do anything to ease their pain, even if it means sacrificing your own well-being.
The Unbreakable Spirit: You are bonded to the idea of your own resilience. You believe that no matter what the Blight takes from you, your spirit will remain unbroken.
The Promise of Power: You are bonded to the idea that with great power comes great responsibility. You will seek to gain power to protect the innocent from the Blight.
The Unseen Enemy: You are bonded to an unseen enemy you feel is responsible for the Blight. You will stop at nothing to hunt them down and destroy them.
The Faded Memory of a Parent: You are bonded to a vague, loving memory of a parent you cannot remember. You search for them in every town and village.
The Last Standing City: You are bonded to the last city standing against the Blight, believing it is the only place left where memories are safe. You will fight to the death to protect it.
The Cursed Object: You are bonded to a cursed object you carry, believing it to be the key to reversing the Blight's effects. You will not part with it, even if it brings you pain.
The Unending Pursuit: You are bonded to an unending pursuit of a goal you can no longer remember. You are a tireless hunter, driven by a purpose you can't define.
The Lost Family: You feel a profound bond to a family you can't remember. You search for them, believing that finding them will restore your memories.
The Forgotten Vow: You are bonded to a vow you made to yourself in the past. You feel a moral obligation to keep it, even if you can no longer remember what it was.
The Unseen Thread: You are bonded to a thread of fate that you believe connects you to Vespera Pyne. You are compelled to follow it to its end, no matter where it leads.
The Burden of Truth: You are bonded to a terrible truth you learned from your past. You will not speak of it, believing it would cause more harm than good.
The Last of a People: You feel a bond to a lost people you are convinced you were once a part of. You are a wanderer, searching for others like you.
The Silent Vow: You are bonded to a silent vow you made to a person you can no longer remember. You will not rest until you have honored it.
The Whispering Wind: You are bonded to the wind, hearing its whispers and believing it carries the memories of the forgotten. You will follow it wherever it goes.
The Broken Lute: You are bonded to a broken lute you carry, a reminder of a song you can no longer remember. You will not rest until you have played it once more.
The Faded Painting: You are bonded to a faded painting you found, believing it is a portrait of your lost love. You search for them in every face you meet.
The Crying Stone: You are bonded to a crying stone you carry, believing it to be a piece of your past that must be returned to its rightful place.
The Unspoken Promise: You are bonded to an unspoken promise you made to yourself. You will not rest until you have honored it.
The Burden of the Past: You are bonded to the weight of your forgotten past, and you will do anything to shed it and start anew.
The Ever-Changing Path: You are bonded to the idea that your path is not set in stone. You will embrace every twist and turn, believing it will lead you to a new beginning.
The Unending Cycle: You are bonded to the idea that the Blight is an unending cycle of creation and destruction. You will seek to break the cycle and find a new way.
The Lost Brother: You are bonded to a lost brother you can no longer remember. You search for them in every crowd, believing they are the only ones who can help you.
The Silent Witness: You are bonded to a silent witness you found in your past. You will protect them at all costs, believing they hold the key to the world's salvation.
The Last of a Dynasty: You are bonded to the idea that you are the last of a forgotten dynasty. You will seek to restore their honor and legacy.
The Broken Vow: You are bonded to a broken vow you made to a person you loved. You will seek to atone for it in every action you take.
